payload.name: Include event memories for hobby-duration questions
payload.description: When a question asks how long someone has been doing a hobby/practice/activity, include event memory kind in searches; do not restrict to preference/state only.
content: For duration questions about an ongoing activity (how long, for how many years, since when), run at least one search with memory_kinds including 'event' (with preference/state), because duration facts are often stored as event records.
If the initial preference/state-only search returns no duration, retry with event kind before answering 'no information'.

solves: Duration questions about a person's hobby or activity were missed because searches restricted memory_kinds to preference/state, while the duration fact was stored as an event record (e.g., 'has been practicing yoga for three years'). The reusable pattern: any 'how long has X been doing Y' query must include event memories, since duration facts for ongoing activities often live in events, not only in preference/state records.
